Description.Name: Get Your Goat
Description.Details: You are making your way through one of the Argo's passageways when you find Jarl Jarlson waiting for you, his expression unusually serious. "Commander, I need to get back to Goat Path. I need to find Sheila." You pause. "Sheila?" "My goat," Jarl replies. "My favorite goat. And before you ask, yes, this is important. I need her to perfect the ammunition for my Lutefisk Launcher." You stare at him for a moment. "Your ammunition requires a goat?" Jarl nods. "Remember the Wizard you rescued on Goat Path? The chemist who gave me the recipe? Specially fermented goat's milk combined with prepared lutefisk. With the proper proportions, it can produce either smoke ammunition or BioGel acid ammunition. But Sheila's milk is essential to getting the mixture right." You remember the strange man clearly, along with the increasingly bizarre circumstances surrounding his rescue. "And you think Sheila is still on Goat Path?" "I hope so." As Jarl speaks, you remember something Captain Jack gave you shortly before he left {COMPANY.CompanyName}. He had pressed a modified electronic whistle into your hand while Jarl was away on a mission. Jack told you that MiG had originally given him the device, and that he had modified it with components he had... procured during his travels. He claimed it could broadcast signals useful for calling or tracking various animals. At the time, you had assumed it was merely another of Jack's eccentric gadgets. You reach into a pocket and produce the device. Jarl stares at it. "What's that?" "Captain Jack gave it to me before he left. He said it might come in handy some day. Perhaps it can help call Sheila." Jarl takes the whistle and examines it carefully, his surprise evident. "Jack modified this?" "Apparently. He never mentioned it to you?" Jarl shakes his head. "No. Jack and I knew each other long before either of us came aboard the Argo, and we both knew MiG, but this is the first I've heard of it." He turns the device over in his hand. "If Jack modified it properly, it may help us locate Sheila when we reach Goat Path. But Sheila is only part of the problem. I still need the components to finish the Lutefisk Launcher." "The twenty-five-tube monstrosity?" Jarl smiles proudly. "Twenty-five mortar tubes, assembled from suitable components taken from two-, four-, six-, and eight-tube mortar launchers, integrated through an FCS Scatter system and the applicable [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_MortarCalibrator],Mortar Calibrator]]. Sheila provides one part of what I need for the ammunition. The mortar parts and FCS Scatter will make the launcher itself possible." You look down at the whistle. "So the plan is to find a goat and then start collecting mortar parts." "Precisely, Commander." "Wait, one part? What's the other part?" Jarl grins broadly, "Lutefisk, of course." You sigh. Somewhere along the way, your mercenary company had apparently become involved in a quest to find a missing goat, some lutefisk and parts to construct a twenty-five-tube lutefisk artillery system. Jarl looks at you expectantly. "Commander, I believe Sheila is waiting for us."

Description.Name: Perhaps at a Later Time
Description.Details: You shake your head. "Not yet. We can't spare the time or the funds to make a trip to Goatpath right now." Jarl's expression falls, though he nods in reluctant understanding. "Then Sheila will have to wait a little longer." You look toward Jarl. "What else do you need?" Jarl straightens. "Parts. The Lutefisk Launcher isn't complete yet. I still need mortar launcher components that can be adapted into the twenty-five-tube assembly, as well as an FCS Scatter system to coordinate the firing pattern. Without those components, finding Sheila only solves part of the ammunition problem. We also need lutefisk to finish the ammo." You nod thoughtfully. "And knowing how you build things, some of those parts may not be easy to come by." Jarl ignores the observation. "We need time to find the proper components and funds to reach Goatpath. Until then, the project remains incomplete." You give the matter one final thought. "Then we wait. When we have the resources, we'll look for Sheila, some lutefisk and the parts you need." Jarl sighs and tucks the modified whistle into his vest pocket. "Not yet, then. But eventually, Commander." Somewhere out there, Sheila is waiting—and apparently so is the twenty-five-tube Lutefisk Launcher.

Description.Name: Let's Goat For it!
Description.Details: "All right. Let's go for it. Set a course for Goatpath. We're going to find Sheila." Jarl breaks into a broad grin. "Excellent, Commander! Once we reach Goatpath, the whistle should help us locate her. And once we've found the goat, we've still got the rest to find." You raise an eyebrow. "The launcher parts?" Jarl nods. "Correct. As well as some lutefisk. Sheila provides the essential ingredient for the ammunition, when combined with lutefisk, but I still need components from existing mortar launchers to construct the Lutefisk Launcher itself. I can adapt parts from two-, four-, six-, or eight-tube mortar launchers, but I also require an FCS Scatter system and the appropriate [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_MortarCalibrator],Mortar Calibrator]] to coordinate all twenty-five tubes." You consider the growing list of requirements. First, travel to Goatpath. Find one missing goat. Source a supplier of lutefisk. Then acquire enough components from existing mortar launchers to build a twenty-five-tube weapon system. Finally, locate an FCS Scatter system capable of controlling it. You look toward the bridge. "Fine. Set the course. First we find Sheila. After that, we start looking for the parts." Jarl grips the modified whistle. "Sheila first. The Lutefisk Launcher second." You turn toward the bridge. "Let's just get this over with." Jarl grins. "Goatpath awaits, Commander."
